_comment: EDIT THE PATHS: replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/kya-os-mcp with the real absolute path of your clone (and the node path with `which node`). Merge the entry into your existing claude_desktop_config.json (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json). Absolute paths are deliberate: Claude Desktop is a GUI app and does NOT have your shell's PATH. The gateway loads the agent key + delegation from the example's .env.local and var/ (anchored to the example dir, not cwd). Fully quit and reopen Claude Desktop after editing. Start `npm run demo` first.
